verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents a public REST API with HTTP Basic Auth, form-encoded requests and JSON responses. It also provides API keys, official SDKs, idempotency headers, many resource endpoints (subscriptions, usage events, exports, quotes, hosted pages), a browser API Explorer, and an llms.txt index that returned HTTP 200 when probed. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
